highlights.excerpt: Turns out that the Starlink software, built for managing the movement of vast amounts of data through space and to the ground, is also very well suited to training super intelligence

highlights.name: Elon Musk
highlights.text_zh: 马斯克称，Starlink 调度天地间海量数据的软件，也很适合用来训练超级智能。

A 3D model of a cell, built entirely from code one organelle at a time. Built by @kevin_t_ngo. https://t.co/3J3JLJZzoD

highlights.excerpt:
Now in beta: Businesses in ChatGPT.

Claim your business, manage your information, and get insights on how people engage with you.

Eligible businesses can also build a Business Agent to answer customers’ questions and help them explore what you offer.

https://t.co/N2GEZX0mFT https://t.co/lYj2Z48fhQ

现已进入测试：ChatGPT 中的商家功能。

认领你的商家、管理信息，并了解人们如何与你互动。

符合条件的商家还可以打造一个 Business Agent，回答客户问题并帮助他们了解你的产品。

highlights.text_zh: ChatGPT 上线商业主页测试：商家可认领资料、看互动，还可做应答客户的 Agent。

highlights.excerpt:
Gemini 4 Carbon is now available.

It’s our strongest model, built to dig deeper, handle long-horizon tasks, and multi-step reasoning.

If Argon is great for complex tasks, Carbon is the model you bring in for your hardest problems.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Gemini 4 Carbon 现已推出。

这是我们最强的模型，为更深挖掘、处理长周期任务和多步推理而打造。

如果说 Argon 擅长复杂任务，Carbon 就是你拿来应对最难问题的模型。
highlights.name: Google
highlights.text_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 发布，Google 称这是其最强模型，擅长长周期任务与多步推理。

highlights.excerpt:
Gemini 4 Carbon, now available in the Gemini API and to Ultra subscribers!

Just a few weeks after Argon was launched, this model makes significant progress on lots of the feedback from Argon and pushes the frontier in cyber, knowledge work, and code! It's a great model : )
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Gemini 4 Carbon 现已在 Gemini API 上线，并向 Ultra 订阅用户开放！

距离 Argon 发布才几周，这个模型就针对大量 Argon 反馈取得明显进展，并在网络安全、知识工作与编程上推进前沿。这是一个很棒的模型 : )
highlights.name: Logan Kilpatrick
highlights.text_zh: Logan：Carbon 已进 Gemini API 与 Ultra，在安全、知识工作与编程上较 Argon 明显进步。

highlights.excerpt:
Gemini Robotics 2.5 is here. 🤖

Our latest physical AI is able to learn hundreds of everyday skills - from folding laundry and serving pastries to autonomously sorting car parts on the factory floor.

Here’s a snapshot of its capabilities 🧵
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Gemini Robotics 2.5 来了。🤖

我们最新的实体 AI 能够学习数百项日常技能——从叠衣服、端点心，到在工厂流水线上自动分拣汽车零件。

下面是它的能力速览 🧵
highlights.name: Google DeepMind
highlights.text_zh: Gemini Robotics 2.5 发布，号称能学数百项日常技能，从叠衣到工厂分拣零件。

highlights.excerpt:
4K image generation in 10 seconds! ⚡

Meet MiniMax H3-Image.

16 million pixel resolution. Stunning realism. Precise prompt following & editing. Up to 16 reference images. All in 10 seconds.

And it's open-weight. 🚀
highlights.excerpt_zh:
10 秒生成 4K 图像！⚡

认识 MiniMax H3-Image。

1600 万像素分辨率。出色的真实感。精确跟随提示词并支持编辑。最多 16 张参考图。全部只要 10 秒。

而且是开源权重。🚀
highlights.name: MiniMax (official)
